messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Contact and Conversation" as it appears in the following examples.
['PLEASE EMAIL ME THROUGH MY private email:smith@sino.net', 'After enrolling to our part-time job you will be contacted by one of our human resource staff.', 'Upon your response, I shall then provide you with more details and that will help you understand the transaction']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Please contact me by private email; after enrollment, a staff member will reach out, and your response will prompt further transaction details."}
